camel_example: aliyun cloudapi SetAppsAuthorities --region cn-hangzhou --StageName TEST --ApiId baacc592e63a4cb6a41920d9d3f91f38 --AppIds '2386789,3389798'
description_en: Grants access permissions on a specified API to multiple applications
description_zh: 给多个 APP 添加指定 API 的访问权限
kebab_example: aliyun cloudapi set-apps-authorities --api-id baacc592e63a4cb6a41920d9d3f91f38 --stage-name TEST --app-ids 2386789,3389798 --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetAppsAuthorities

parameters.help_en: The ID of the API group. This ID is generated by the system and globally unique
parameters.help_zh: API分组ID，系统生成，全局唯一
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the API. This ID is generated by the system and globally unique
parameters.help_zh: API编号，系统生成，全局唯一
parameters.name: api_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the runtime environment. Valid values:

RELEASE

TEST
parameters.help_zh:
环境名称，取值为：

RELEASE：线上
TEST：测试
parameters.name: stage_name

parameters.help_en: The IDs of applications. Separate multiple application IDs with commas (,). A maximum of 100 applications IDs can be entered
parameters.help_zh: 指定要操作的app编号，支持输入多个，“,”分隔，最多支持100个
parameters.name: app_ids

parameters.help_en: The time (UTC) when the authorization expires. If this parameter is empty, the authorization does not expire
parameters.help_zh: 授权有效时间的截止时间，请设置格林尼治标准时间(GMT)，如果为空，即为授权永久有效
parameters.name: auth_valid_time
